signal: CSTrace raw indirect incident D=E/pi, before temporal/filter/composite
notes: Authored geometry, material inputs and light units must be frozen before native execution; never infer them from observed GI RGB.
MPB BaseColor is shader-linear. Do not apply another sRGB conversion. A Material authoring-color path requires a different explicit source contract.
World source diffuse is 0.96*(1-metallic)*baseColor*proxyTint. All selected components are below the existing 0.98 transport cap.
The light color is the URP-relative direct diffuse quantity. No extra division by pi is applied to wall outgoing radiance.
A separate diagnostic sampler may supply directions using identical Work.frame, pixel and normal. It must export no product hit/color/PDF as an oracle answer.
Only the declared rectangle and upward floor may intersect these rays. No other geometry or cache contribution is permitted.
The infinite-sample analytic expectation is a reference, not a pass threshold for one finite noisy frame. Finite sample comparison is independent ray/rectangle evaluation.
